title: Hatsune Miku — The Top Karuta-Playing Idol?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It is time...
Let us commence this Karuta battle!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Good luck, you two!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm not sure who to root for...
I sort of want them both to win somehow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, you've been working all week on this with Rin. What's her condition like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She seems a little nervous, but she should be fine as long as she does what we practiced!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Crickets chirping...”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Got it!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh wow! Rin got the first card! She's off to an auspicious start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She certainly is! It's one of her best cards too...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Now I see...
You've come a long way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess I'll need to step up my game too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's no way I'm losing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “At daybreak...”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Be careful here, Rin! Remember that there are two poems that start with that...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “When the mists on the Uji River...”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mine!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Incredible! He listened so patiently there just now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How is he able to do that?
He's only played once before, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I remember him mentioning that he borrowed a book about Hyakunin Isshu from Airi. He must've spent some time studying everything as well...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I had that one...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're doing great, Rin!
Just focus on the next one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just try your best and you'll do fine! Don't forget to keep believing in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You can do it, Rin...!!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's move on to the next one.
“Through a sleepless night...”

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: There!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was the last one...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, it was!
Let's see the results!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Who do you think won...?
It was so close the entire time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it was. I kept count through most of it but lost track because of all the excitement.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin wins by one card...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I... I did it!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: C-Congratulations, Rin!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!!
I couldn't have done it without you, Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Darn. I really tried my best too. I probably lost because Rin actually took the time to memorize everything...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But you were also spectacular, Len.
You had this cool expression on you the entire time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. It was an instant classic.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're really bawling, Rin. Let me get you a handkerchief... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-You're crying too, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
B-Because I'm so happy for you...!
You did such an amazing job back there...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku...!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Rin was understandably nervous, but I guess Miku was just as anxious. I'm glad for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After all, she worked hand-in-hand with Rin for this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
All true...
What they've achieved is so beautiful...! Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, KAITO, can you help me practice after this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know this is gonna sound really childish, but I can't let Rin hog all the glory...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course! It'd be my pleasure...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a great teacher, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I'm not talking about just this. I feel like I can do anything now because I know you'll be there for me...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so kind of you.
I couldn't ask for a more wonderful way to start off the new year♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's both keep trying our best, Rin!
We should be able to accomplish anything as long as we're together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
